import json,re,pathlib
d=json.load(open('products/research/go-hybrid-payout/extract.json'))
kw=re.compile(r'paid|payout|pay out|sent|transfer|tx|transaction|basescan|USDC|wallet|winner|verdict|closes|deadline|cycle|eligib|KYC|PayPal|GitHub Sponsors|0x[0-9a-fA-F]{6}',re.I)
res=[]
for n,o in d.items():
    ls=o['text'].split('\n')
    res.append('=== %s %s lines=%d'%(n,o['title'],len(ls)))
    seen=set()
    for i,l in enumerate(ls):
        if kw.search(l) and len(l)>25 and l not in seen:
            seen.add(l);res.append('[%d] %s'%(i,l[:600]))
s='\n'.join(res)
pathlib.Path('products/research/go-hybrid-payout/keyword-lines.txt').write_text(s)
print(len(s))
